outcome: Perinatal complications (mortality, birth trauma, hyperbilirubinemia, hypoglycemia)
finding: Neonatal and obstetric outcomes were comparable between women with GDM treated with diet-only or additional insulin therapy, although the incidence of LGA neonates was significantly increased in the GDM cohort compared to the general obstetric population.
mod_finding: Women in the insulin group underwent more planned Cesarean sections compared to the diet-only group.
birth_weight: Neonates born in the insulin group had a lower birth weight compared with the diet group (3364 vs. 3467 g, p = 0.005)
